resources.string: Allows the dashboard to remotely control this device via touch gestures when remote control mode is explicitly enabled. Requires user consent in Accessibility settings.
Configure your server connection and pair this device

This app requires several permissions to monitor and manage your device. All permissions are optional and can be granted or revoked at any time. The app will clearly indicate when a permission is missing and will never attempt to bypass Android security.

Key permissions:
• Location — for GPS tracking
• Camera — for remote photo capture
• Microphone — for screen recording audio
• Notifications — for monitoring notifications
• Contacts/Call Log/SMS — for syncing personal data
• Usage Access — for app usage statistics
• Screen Capture — for screen recording (requires user consent each time)
